justifications.durability: The two readers converge on one resolver, the test pins both the run's own head and the checkout's later head (asserting the latter is absent), and the negative control reddens its case, so the check is not vacuous. Deducted one because the section's goal — no reader of a reclaimed run's review head reaches the checkout's HEAD — is enforced only by the two pinned call sites; nothing structurally prevents a future third reader from calling recovery._reviewed_run_head directly, and such a reintroduction would fail no test. The mechanism is right; its guard is pointwise rather than structural.
justifications.evidence: Strong and independently reproduced. logs/base-arm.log (base source + the new test, 3 failed / 22 passed EXIT=1), logs/head-arm.log (delivered worktree, 1 failed / 24 passed EXIT=1), and logs/negative-control.log (sub-floor reader routed back to _reviewed_run_head, its case 1 failed EXIT=1) are well-formed, and the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite JSON matches them. The reviewer rebuilt a base tree from revision 67c5188478 with the two source files reverted and reproduced 2 failed for the two new cases; re-ran the delivered four-file head gate and reproduced exactly '1 failed, 24 passed' with the same single pre-existing id; and confirmed test_crew_help_names_its_state fails identically at base, so zero failure ids are added.
justifications.fit: Reuses the existing recovery._review_head_and_tree resolver rather than adding a second one, keeps the change to two call sites plus one test module, and lands as conventional commits (fix, then a docs(evidence) anchor) each with a body stating what and why. No plan, sprint or ticket identifier appears in code, symbols or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The done-when is met exactly. Both readers now take head and tree from recovery._review_head_and_tree at reckon/cli.py:4943 (crew disposition) and reckon/crew/obligations.py:677 (the sub-floor dimension duty); a grep of reckon/ finds no remaining caller of recovery._reviewed_run_head outside the resolver itself (recovery.py:1311), so no reader resolves a reclaimed run's review head from the shared checkout. The new test drives each reader on a run whose manifest cites its head by a nine-character id and asserts the full forty-character id reaches select_review_for_head; independently reproduced green at head (2 passed) and red at base (2 failed).
justifications.scope_discipline: Change is confined to the declared write paths: reckon/cli.py (+2/-2), reckon/crew/obligations.py (-26/+9, the reader plus removal of the duplicated _reviewed_tree helper), the new tests/test_one_review_head_resolver.py, and the evidence anchor docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/one-review-head-resolver.html.
